summary: Diff adds a client-side drug list verification utility and updates the Drug Database UI module with full-list filtering and pagination scaffolding, plus new query hooks for refresh+verify. However, there is no evidence that the curated drug dataset file was updated (REQ-1), nor clear evidence that backend drug query methods were fixed to prevent truncation (REQ-2). Several unrelated frontend features/UI changes are also indicated in the file summaries.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the curated drug dataset so the complete drug list is up to date and includes missing entries, with required fields and deterministic deduplication behavior.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not show any modification to `frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts` contents (only a new import from it). Without a diff for that dataset file, there is no evidence the dataset itself was updated or that entries were added/changed to meet required fields and deduplication acceptance criteria.
evidence: frontend/src/services/drugListVerification.ts (imports normalizeDrugName from curatedDrugDataset, but does not modify the dataset)
No diff entry shown for frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure backend drug query methods return complete datasets with correct filtering, independent of user profile state (no truncation in getAllDrugs/approved/banned results).
missing_requirements.reason: The `backend/main.mo` diff content shown is truncated and contains only type definitions in the excerpt; there is no evidence in the provided diff summary that `getAllDrugs` or other drug query methods were changed to address truncation or filtering correctness.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated excerpt shows type declarations only; no getAllDrugs/approved/banned implementation changes visible)

missing_requirements.requirement: A single user action triggers refresh/update of the drug dataset and then verification; verification results are exposed to the UI with success/failure and human-readable failure summary.

The file summary claims new hooks exist, but the shown `useQueries.ts` excerpt is truncated before the drug-related additions.

frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (truncated; drug verification hooks not visible in excerpt)
